fields.name: 🧹 MinIO Out-of-Band Media Prune & Audit Log

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.media_uri') AS media_uri, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.bucket') AS bucket, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.object_key') AS object_key, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.http_status') AS INTEGER) AS http_status, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.execution_status') AS status FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MediaPruneAudit' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 25

view.title: MinIO Physical Storage Reclaim Audit Log

fields.name: 🎯 Media Prune Candidates (4:00 AM CEL Pipeline)

query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS timestamp, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.media_uri') AS media_uri, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.source_message_type') AS source_type, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.reason') AS reason FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MediaPruneCandidate' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 20
